episode_summary: Brenton Miebach shares his journey of moving to new markets and achieving rapid success through AI-driven marketing systems and paid leads. He discusses the importance of mastering the local market, leveraging AI for operational efficiency, and using social media to build a personal brand. The episode offers actionable insights for agents looking to scale their business and integrate technology into their operations.
